candidates.reason: Hypothesis: one CTE can isolate the day filter and project only route keys before aggregation. Keeping the original predicate and COUNT(*) preserves NULL handling, duplicate counts, anomalous-date behavior, aliases, and DuckDB result types.
candidates.sql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff
  FROM trips
  WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
)
SELECT pickup, dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM selected
GROUP BY pickup, dropoff
